gloss: to go back to square one; to start over from scratch

definitions.gloss: to go back to square one; to return to the starting point
definitions.explanation: To lose all progress and have to start over from the beginning. Originally from board games where a player is sent back to the start square.

examples.japanese: ⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{振|ふ}り{出|だ}しに{戻|もど}った。
examples.english: The plan went back to square one.

examples.japanese: ⟦ミス→ミス：00285_misu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つかって→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧、{振|ふ}り{出|だ}しに{戻|もど}ることになった。
examples.english: A mistake was found, and we had to go back to the beginning.

examples.japanese: せっかく⟦{半年|はんとし}→半年：03139_hantoshi⟧⟦かけて→かける：00854_kakeru⟧⟦{準備|じゅんび}した→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{予算|よさん}→予算：03663_yosan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{振|ふ}り{出|だ}しに{戻|もど}ってしまった。
examples.english: Even though we spent half a year preparing, a budget issue sent everything back to square one.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
From the start square (⟦{振|ふ}り{出|だ}し→振り出し：15931_furidashi⟧) in traditional Japanese board games like sugoroku, where landing on certain squares sends you back to the beginning.

USAGE:
Used when progress is completely lost and one must restart from zero. Carries a sense of frustration or disappointment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{全|すべ}て→全て：03822_subete⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{振|ふ}り{出|だ}しに{戻|もど}る (everything goes back to square one)
- {振|ふ}り{出|だ}しに{戻|もど}ること⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ (end up going back to the start)
- ⟦また→また：00969_mata⟧{振|ふ}り{出|だ}しに{戻|もど}る (go back to square one again)
